integrity: Mathematical proof and exact reproducible finite computation supplied; the infinite tail uses Weil character-sum bounds. Reproduction of finite checks does not constitute independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Existence classification restricted to a single sixth-power coset in odd-characteristic fields of order 1 modulo 6; not an exact witness count or a general NSNP triple classification. Finite exceptional-field verification relies on inspectable code and standard finite-field algebra. Published priority uncertain for Buell--Hudson 1986 and other unindexed tables.
title: Complete exceptional-field classification for three consecutive nonsquare cubes
